## Modules

- [ADK.Agent.BaseAgent](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Agent.BaseAgent.md): Shared utilities for all agent types.
- [ADK.Agent.Clone](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Agent.Clone.md): Clone utility for ADK agent structs.
- [ADK.Agent.RemoteA2aAgent](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Agent.RemoteA2aAgent.md): Agent that communicates with a remote A2A agent via A2A client.
- [ADK.AgentConfig](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.AgentConfig.md): Load agent configurations from YAML files or strings.
- [ADK.Agents.ContextCacheConfig](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Agents.ContextCacheConfig.md): Configuration for context caching.

- [ADK.ApigeeLlm](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.ApigeeLlm.md): Apigee LLM router.
- [ADK.Artifact.Util](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Artifact.Util.md): Utility functions for handling artifact URIs.
- [ADK.Auth](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.md): Authentication subsystem for the Agent Development Kit (ADK).
- [ADK.Auth.CredentialManager](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.CredentialManager.md): Stateless orchestrator for the full OAuth2 / credential lifecycle.
- [ADK.Auth.Exchanger](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Exchanger.md): Behaviour for credential exchangers.
- [ADK.Auth.Exchanger.OAuth2](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Exchanger.OAuth2.md): Exchanges OAuth2 credentials from authorization responses.
- [ADK.Auth.Exchanger.Registry](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Exchanger.Registry.md): Registry for credential exchangers.
- [ADK.Auth.Exchanger.ServiceAccount](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Exchanger.ServiceAccount.md): Exchanges Google Service Account credentials for an HTTP Bearer token.
Mirrors Python ADK's `ServiceAccountCredentialExchanger`.

- [ADK.Auth.Google](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Google.md): Google Authentication integration behavior for ADK.
Allows fetching application default credentials or explicit service account tokens.

- [ADK.Auth.Handler](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Handler.md): Orchestrates the OAuth2 authentication flow for ADK tools.
- [ADK.Auth.OAuth2](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.OAuth2.md): Core OAuth2 HTTP operations: authorization URL generation, auth code exchange,
and token refresh.
- [ADK.Auth.OAuth2.AuthorizationServerMetadata](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.OAuth2.AuthorizationServerMetadata.md): Represents the metadata of an OAuth2 authorization server.

- [ADK.Auth.OAuth2.ProtectedResourceMetadata](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.OAuth2.ProtectedResourceMetadata.md): Represents the metadata of an OAuth2 protected resource.

- [ADK.Auth.OAuth2Discovery](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.OAuth2Discovery.md): Discovers OAuth2 metadata for authorization servers and protected resources.

- [ADK.Auth.Preprocessor](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Preprocessor.md): Pre-processes auth credential responses before an LLM request.
- [ADK.Auth.Provider](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Provider.md): Behavior for custom authentication providers.
- [ADK.Auth.ProviderRegistry](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.ProviderRegistry.md): Registry for dynamic auth providers.
- [ADK.Auth.Refresher](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Refresher.md): Behaviour for credential refreshers.
- [ADK.Auth.Refresher.Registry](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Refresher.Registry.md): Registry for credential refreshers.
- [ADK.Auth.ToolsetAuth](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.ToolsetAuth.md): Resolves toolset-level authentication before tools are available.
- [ADK.CLI.AgentChangeHandler](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.CLI.AgentChangeHandler.md): Decides whether a file change should trigger an agent reload.
- [ADK.Context.Compressor.TokenBudget](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Context.Compressor.TokenBudget.md): Token budget compaction strategy — keeps conversation history within a
configurable token limit.
- [ADK.DevServer.Router](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.DevServer.Router.md): Plug router for the ADK development server (`mix adk.server`).
- [ADK.EventCompaction](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.EventCompaction.md): The compaction of the events.

- [ADK.Feature](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Feature.md): Feature flag registry for experimental and in-progress features.
- [ADK.Flows.LlmFlows.RequestConfirmation](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Flows.LlmFlows.RequestConfirmation.md): Handles tool confirmation information to build the LLM request.
- [ADK.Flows.LlmFlows.TranscriptionManager](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Flows.LlmFlows.TranscriptionManager.md): Manages transcription events for live streaming flows.

- [ADK.Guardrail](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Guardrail.md): Behaviour for input/output validation guardrails.
- [ADK.Guardrail.ContentFilter](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Guardrail.ContentFilter.md): Guardrail that blocks content matching specified patterns.
- [ADK.Guardrail.Schema](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Guardrail.Schema.md): Guardrail that validates output is valid JSON matching expected keys.
- [ADK.Harness](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Harness.md): The simplest way to run an agent. Structure around execution:
budgets, guardrails, hooks, and feedback loops.
- [ADK.Harness.Budget](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Harness.Budget.md): Token/step/time budget tracking for `ADK.Harness`.
- [ADK.Harness.Config](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Harness.Config.md): Configuration struct for `ADK.Harness` execution.
- [ADK.Harness.Feedback](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Harness.Feedback.md): Feedback loop for agent self-verification.
- [ADK.LLM.Gateway](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Gateway.md): Multi-key LLM provider management with key pooling, stats, and failover.
- [ADK.LLM.Gateway.Auth](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Gateway.Auth.md): Common auth struct for LLM provider credentials.
- [ADK.LLM.Gateway.Budget](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Gateway.Budget.md): Token budget tracking and enforcement for LLM Gateway requests.
- [ADK.LLM.Gateway.Config](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Gateway.Config.md): Configuration parsing and validation for LLM Gateway.
- [ADK.LLM.Gateway.KeyPool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Gateway.KeyPool.md): GenServer managing multiple API keys for one logical backend with rotation strategies.
- [ADK.LLM.Gateway.Scheduler](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Gateway.Scheduler.md): Priority queue scheduler for LLM Gateway requests.
- [ADK.LLM.Gateway.Stats](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Gateway.Stats.md): ETS-based stats collection for LLM Gateway requests.
- [ADK.LLM.Gemma](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Gemma.md): Gemma LLM backend, extending the Gemini backend with Gemma-specific
preprocessing and postprocessing.
- [ADK.LLM.Router](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Router.md): Smart LLM router with failover across backends/models, exponential backoff,
and rate-limit awareness.
- [ADK.MCP.Toolset](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.MCP.Toolset.md): MCP Toolset — connects to an MCP server via stdio and provides its tools
as ADK `FunctionTool` structs.
- [ADK.Memory.Store.VertexAI](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Memory.Store.VertexAI.md): Vertex AI Agent Engine Memory Bank store implementation.
- [ADK.Models.CacheMetadata](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Models.CacheMetadata.md): Metadata for context cache associated with LLM responses.
- [ADK.Models.GeminiContextCacheManager](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Models.GeminiContextCacheManager.md): Manages context cache lifecycle for Gemini models.
- [ADK.Models.InteractionsUtils](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Models.InteractionsUtils.md): Utilities for the Interactions API integration.
- [ADK.Models.LlmRequest](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Models.LlmRequest.md): LLM request struct that allows passing in tools, output schema and system
instructions to the model.

- [ADK.Models.LlmResponse](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Models.LlmResponse.md): LLM response struct that provides the first candidate response from the
model if available. Otherwise, returns error code and message.

- [ADK.Oban.ScheduledJob](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Oban.ScheduledJob.md): Oban worker for recurring/scheduled agent runs via Oban cron.
- [ADK.Phoenix.ControlLive](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Phoenix.ControlLive.md): Phoenix LiveView dashboard for observing ADK agent system state in real-time.
- [ADK.Phoenix.ControlLive.Store](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Phoenix.ControlLive.Store.md): In-memory telemetry event accumulator for the ControlPlane dashboard.
- [ADK.Phoenix.FlowLive](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Phoenix.FlowLive.md): Read-only Phoenix LiveView component for visualizing agent graphs.
- [ADK.Phoenix.LiveSocket](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Phoenix.LiveSocket.md): Handles the `run_live` WebSocket connection for the ADK.

- [ADK.Phoenix.WebServerClient](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Phoenix.WebServerClient.md): HTTP client for interacting with the ADK web server for conformance tests.
- [ADK.Planner](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Planner.md): Behaviour for Agent Planners.
- [ADK.Planner.BuiltIn](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Planner.BuiltIn.md): The built-in planner that uses the model's built-in thinking features.

- [ADK.Planner.PlanReAct](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Planner.PlanReAct.md): Plan-Re-Act planner that constrains the LLM response to generate a plan
before any action/observation.

- [ADK.Plugin.BigQueryAgentAnalytics](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.BigQueryAgentAnalytics.md): A plugin for logging ADK execution events to Google BigQuery.

- [ADK.Plugin.BigQueryAgentAnalytics.DefaultClient](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.BigQueryAgentAnalytics.DefaultClient.md)
- [ADK.Plugin.Cache](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.Cache.md): A simple in-memory response cache plugin using ETS.
- [ADK.Plugin.ContextFilter](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.ContextFilter.md): A plugin that filters the LLM context to reduce its size.

- [ADK.Plugin.DebugLogging](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.DebugLogging.md): A plugin that logs debug information for ADK runs, saving states to a file.
Parity with Python's DebugLoggingPlugin.

- [ADK.Plugin.GlobalInstruction](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.GlobalInstruction.md): Plugin that provides global instructions functionality at the App level.
- [ADK.Plugin.Logging](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.Logging.md): A plugin that wraps every run with structured log output.
- [ADK.Plugin.MultimodalToolResults](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.MultimodalToolResults.md): A plugin that modifies function tool responses to support returning list of parts directly.
- [ADK.Plugin.RateLimit](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.RateLimit.md): A sliding-window rate limiter plugin.
- [ADK.Plugin.ReflectRetryTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.ReflectRetryTool.md): Provides self-healing, concurrent-safe error recovery for tool failures.

- [ADK.Plugin.SaveFilesAsArtifacts](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.SaveFilesAsArtifacts.md): Intercepts user messages and saves attached files as artifacts.

- [ADK.Policy.HumanApproval](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Policy.HumanApproval.md): A policy that pauses agent execution and requires human approval before
running sensitive tools — Human-in-the-loop (HITL) tool confirmation.
- [ADK.Session.GetSessionConfig](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.GetSessionConfig.md)
- [ADK.Session.Migration](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.Migration.md): Utilities for database schema version detection and migration.
- [ADK.Session.Recovery](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.Recovery.md): Recovers active sessions after application restart.
- [ADK.Session.Store.Ecto.DynamicTermType](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.Store.Ecto.DynamicTermType.md): Parity for Python's DynamicPickleType.
- [ADK.Session.Store.SQLite](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.Store.SQLite.md): SQLite-backed session store with FTS5 full-text search on events.
- [ADK.Session.Store.VertexAI](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.Store.VertexAI.md): Vertex AI Agent Engine Session Service store implementation.

- [ADK.Skill](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Skill.md): A Skill is a reusable bundle of instructions (and optionally tools)
that can be loaded from a directory and mixed into an LlmAgent.
- [ADK.Skill.Deps](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Skill.Deps.md): Checks availability of external dependencies required by skills.
- [ADK.Skill.ExecTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Skill.ExecTool.md): Wraps a shell (`.sh`) or Python (`.py`) script as an ADK tool.
- [ADK.Skill.Loader](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Skill.Loader.md): Enhanced skill directory loader that auto-discovers tools from
- [ADK.Skill.Script](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Skill.Script.md): Discovers and wraps scripts in a skill's `scripts/` directory as ADK tools.
- [ADK.Skill.Steps](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Skill.Steps.md): DSL for declaring skill steps that auto-dagify into workflows.
- [ADK.Skill.Supervisor](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Skill.Supervisor.md): DynamicSupervisor that manages MCP server processes for a skill.
- [ADK.Skill.Toolset](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Skill.Toolset.md): Progressive disclosure toolset for skills.
- [ADK.SystemInstruction](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.SystemInstruction.md): Renders a system instruction template.

- [ADK.Telemetry.Contract](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Telemetry.Contract.md): Canonical contract for all `:adk.*` telemetry events.
- [ADK.Telemetry.DefaultHandler](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Telemetry.DefaultHandler.md): A simple Logger-based telemetry handler for development.
- [ADK.Telemetry.GoogleCloud](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Telemetry.GoogleCloud.md): Google Cloud OpenTelemetry integration for ADK Elixir.
Parity with adk-python's google.adk.telemetry.google_cloud.

- [ADK.Token](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Token.md): Standalone token estimation utility.
- [ADK.Tool.ApplicationIntegrationTool.ApplicationIntegrationToolset](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.ApplicationIntegrationTool.ApplicationIntegrationToolset.md): ApplicationIntegrationToolset generates tools from a given Application Integration
or Integration Connector resource.

- [ADK.Tool.ApplicationIntegrationTool.Clients.ConnectionsClient](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.ApplicationIntegrationTool.Clients.ConnectionsClient.md)
- [ADK.Tool.ApplicationIntegrationTool.Clients.IntegrationClient](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.ApplicationIntegrationTool.Clients.IntegrationClient.md)
- [ADK.Tool.ApplicationIntegrationTool.IntegrationConnectorTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.ApplicationIntegrationTool.IntegrationConnectorTool.md)
- [ADK.Tool.Approval](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.Approval.md): GenServer that manages pending human approval requests for tool calls.
- [ADK.Tool.BashTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.BashTool.md): Tool to execute bash commands.
- [ADK.Tool.BigQuery.Client](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.BigQuery.Client.md): A client for BigQuery in ADK Elixir.
Provides configuration and default user agents for BigQuery and Dataplex clients.

- [ADK.Tool.BigQuery.CredentialsConfig](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.BigQuery.CredentialsConfig.md): BigQuery Credentials Configuration for Google API tools (Experimental).
- [ADK.Tool.BigQuery.DataInsightsTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.BigQuery.DataInsightsTool.md): Answers questions about structured data in BigQuery tables using natural language.
- [ADK.Tool.BigQuery.SearchTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.BigQuery.SearchTool.md): Finds BigQuery datasets and tables using natural language semantic search via Dataplex.
- [ADK.Tool.Bigtable.CredentialsConfig](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.Bigtable.CredentialsConfig.md): Bigtable Credentials Configuration for Google API tools.
- [ADK.Tool.Confirmation](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.Confirmation.md): Represents a tool confirmation configuration.
- [ADK.Tool.DataAgent.CredentialsConfig](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.DataAgent.CredentialsConfig.md): Credentials Configuration for Data Agent tools.
- [ADK.Tool.DataAgent.DataAgentTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.DataAgent.DataAgentTool.md): A tool returned by DataAgentToolset.
- [ADK.Tool.DataAgent.DataAgentToolset](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.DataAgent.DataAgentToolset.md): Data Agent Toolset contains tools for interacting with data agents.

- [ADK.Tool.DataAgent.ToolConfig](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.DataAgent.ToolConfig.md): Configuration for Data Agent tools.
- [ADK.Tool.ExitLoop](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.ExitLoop.md): Built-in tool that allows an LLM inside a `LoopAgent` to break out of the loop.
- [ADK.Tool.GoogleApiTool.GoogleApiToOpenApiConverter](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.GoogleApiTool.GoogleApiToOpenApiConverter.md): Converts Google API Discovery documents to OpenAPI v3 format.

- [ADK.Tool.LongRunningTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.LongRunningTool.md): An asynchronous tool that executes work in a supervised BEAM process.
- [ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.Auth.AuthHelpers](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.Auth.AuthHelpers.md): Authentication helpers for OpenAPI tools.
Mirrors Python ADK's `google.adk.tools.openapi_tool.auth.auth_helpers`.

- [ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.OpenApiToolset](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.OpenApiToolset.md): Tool set that generates tools from an OpenAPI specification.

- [ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.RestApiTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.RestApiTool.md): A tool that represents a single operation from an OpenAPI specification.

- [ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.SpecParser](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.SpecParser.md): Parses an OpenAPI specification into a list of operations.

- [ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.SpecParser.ApiParameter](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.SpecParser.ApiParameter.md)
- [ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.SpecParser.OperationEndpoint](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.SpecParser.OperationEndpoint.md)
- [ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.SpecParser.ParsedOperation](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.OpenApiTool.SpecParser.ParsedOperation.md)
- [ADK.Tool.ResultGuard](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.ResultGuard.md): Truncates oversized tool results to protect the LLM context window.
- [ADK.Tool.Toolset](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.Toolset.md): Behaviour for toolsets — collections of tools that may require
authentication before their tools can be used.
- [ADK.Transcript.Repair](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Transcript.Repair.md): Repairs conversation transcripts to satisfy Gemini API turn-ordering rules.
- [ADK.Utils.Common](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Utils.Common.md): Core common utility functions.
Includes formatting, date/time utilities, and map manipulation functions.

- [ADK.Workflow](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.md): Graph-based workflow executor for composing agents into DAGs.
- [ADK.Workflow.Checkpoint](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Checkpoint.md): Checkpoint behaviour for persisting workflow execution state.
- [ADK.Workflow.Checkpoint.EctoStore](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Checkpoint.EctoStore.md): Ecto-backed checkpoint store for durable workflow state persistence.
- [ADK.Workflow.Checkpoint.EtsStore](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Checkpoint.EtsStore.md): ETS-backed checkpoint store for fast in-process workflow state persistence.
- [ADK.Workflow.Collaboration](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Collaboration.md): Collaboration modes for workflow fan-out nodes.
- [ADK.Workflow.Executor](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Executor.md): Graph traversal and execution engine for workflows.
- [ADK.Workflow.Graph](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Graph.md): Graph data structure for workflow definitions.
- [ADK.Workflow.Graph.Mutation](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Graph.Mutation.md): Functional mutations for workflow graphs.
- [ADK.Workflow.Graph.Runtime](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Graph.Runtime.md): GenServer that wraps a graph and allows atomic mutations during execution.
- [ADK.Workflow.Graph.Validator](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Graph.Validator.md): Validates workflow graph structure.
- [ADK.Workflow.Retry](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Retry.md): Per-node retry logic for workflow steps.
- [ADK.Workflow.Step](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Workflow.Step.md): Represents a single workflow step with support for execution and compensation.

- [Adk.Agents.InstructionProvider](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Adk.Agents.InstructionProvider.md)
- [Adk.Agents.McpInstructionProvider](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Adk.Agents.McpInstructionProvider.md): Instruction provider that fetches a prompt from an MCP server.

- [Adk.Agents.ReadonlyContext](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Adk.Agents.ReadonlyContext.md)
- [Adk.Mcp.SessionManager](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Adk.Mcp.SessionManager.md)
- [Adk.Mcp.SessionManagerImpl](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Adk.Mcp.SessionManagerImpl.md): Default stub implementation of `Adk.Mcp.SessionManager`.
- [Adk.ReadonlyContext](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Adk.ReadonlyContext.md): A read-only snapshot of invocation context for instruction providers.
- [Adk.WebServer.Cors](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Adk.WebServer.Cors.md)

- Core
  - [ADK](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.md): The main entry point for ADK Elixir.
  - [ADK.Agent](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Agent.md): The core agent protocol. Every agent type implements this.
  - [ADK.Context](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Context.md): Invocation context threaded through the agent pipeline.
  - [ADK.Event](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Event.md): Represents an event in the ADK.

  - [ADK.Tool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.md): The tool behaviour. Tools are functions that agents can call.

  - [ADK.ToolContext](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.ToolContext.md): Context passed to tool execution, providing access to session state,
artifacts, credentials, and agent transfer capabilities.

- Agents
  - [ADK.Agent.Custom](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Agent.Custom.md): A simple agent that wraps a function. Useful for testing and ad-hoc agents.
  - [ADK.Agent.LlmAgent](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Agent.LlmAgent.md): An LLM-powered agent that calls a language model to generate responses,
handles tool calls, and loops until a final text response is produced.
  - [ADK.Agent.LoopAgent](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Agent.LoopAgent.md): Runs sub-agents in a loop until a maximum number of iterations is reached,
an exit_condition returns true, or an agent signals escalation via `EventActions.escalate`.
  - [ADK.Agent.ParallelAgent](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Agent.ParallelAgent.md): Runs sub-agents concurrently using `Task.async_stream`, collecting all events.
  - [ADK.Agent.SequentialAgent](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Agent.SequentialAgent.md): Runs sub-agents in sequence, passing state through the session.

- Tools
  - [ADK.Tool.BuiltInCodeExecution](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.BuiltInCodeExecution.md): Built-in Code Execution tool for Gemini models.
  - [ADK.Tool.Declarative](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.Declarative.md): Macro-based tool declaration using `@tool` module attributes.
  - [ADK.Tool.FunctionTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.FunctionTool.md): Wraps any function as a tool with declaration metadata.
  - [ADK.Tool.GoogleSearch](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.GoogleSearch.md): Built-in Google Search tool for Gemini models.
  - [ADK.Tool.ModuleTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.ModuleTool.md): A tool backed by a module instead of an anonymous function.
  - [ADK.Tool.SearchMemoryTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.SearchMemoryTool.md): Built-in tool that lets agents search long-term memory.
  - [ADK.Tool.TransferToAgent](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.TransferToAgent.md): Built-in tool that enables an agent to transfer control to a sub-agent.
  - [ADK.Tool.TransferTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Tool.TransferTool.md): Auto-generated tool for transferring control to a sub-agent.

- LLM Backends
  - [ADK.LLM](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.md): LLM behaviour and mock implementation for testing.
  - [ADK.LLM.Anthropic](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Anthropic.md): Anthropic Claude LLM backend using the Messages API via Req.
  - [ADK.LLM.CircuitBreaker](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.CircuitBreaker.md): Simple circuit breaker for LLM calls using GenServer.
  - [ADK.LLM.Gemini](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Gemini.md): Gemini LLM backend using the REST API via Req.
  - [ADK.LLM.Mock](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Mock.md): Mock LLM that echoes input or uses pattern matching.
  - [ADK.LLM.OpenAI](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.OpenAI.md): OpenAI-compatible LLM backend using the chat completions API via Req.
  - [ADK.LLM.Retry](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.LLM.Retry.md): Retry wrapper for LLM calls with exponential backoff and jitter.

- Sessions &amp; State
  - [ADK.EventActions](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.EventActions.md): Actions attached to an event — state deltas, transfers, escalation.
  - [ADK.RunConfig](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.RunConfig.md): Configuration struct for controlling Runner execution behavior.
  - [ADK.Session](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.md): Session GenServer — one process per active session.
  - [ADK.Session.Store](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.Store.md): Behaviour for session persistence stores.
  - [ADK.Session.Store.Ecto](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.Store.Ecto.md): Ecto-backed session store.
  - [ADK.Session.Store.InMemory](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.Store.InMemory.md): ETS-backed in-memory session store.
  - [ADK.Session.Store.JsonFile](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Session.Store.JsonFile.md): File-based JSON session store.
  - [ADK.State.Delta](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.State.Delta.md): Immutable snapshot + diff for state delta tracking.

- Memory
  - [ADK.Memory.Entry](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Memory.Entry.md): A single memory entry.
  - [ADK.Memory.InMemory](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Memory.InMemory.md): ETS-backed in-memory memory store for development and testing.
  - [ADK.Memory.Store](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Memory.Store.md): Behaviour for memory services.

- Context &amp; Compression
  - [ADK.Context.Compressor](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Context.Compressor.md): Behaviour for context compression strategies.
  - [ADK.Context.Compressor.SlidingWindow](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Context.Compressor.SlidingWindow.md): Sliding window strategy — keeps system messages plus the last N messages,
with awareness of function call/response pairs.
  - [ADK.Context.Compressor.Summarize](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Context.Compressor.Summarize.md): Summarization strategy — uses an LLM to condense older messages.
  - [ADK.Context.Compressor.Truncate](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Context.Compressor.Truncate.md): Simple truncation strategy — keeps system messages and the last N messages.

- Artifacts
  - [ADK.Artifact.GCS](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Artifact.GCS.md): Google Cloud Storage artifact backend.
  - [ADK.Artifact.InMemory](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Artifact.InMemory.md): In-memory artifact store backed by an Agent process.
  - [ADK.Artifact.Store](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Artifact.Store.md): Behaviour for pluggable artifact storage backends.

- Auth
  - [ADK.Auth.Config](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Config.md): Declares authentication requirements for a tool.
  - [ADK.Auth.Credential](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.Credential.md): Represents an authentication credential.
  - [ADK.Auth.CredentialStore](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.CredentialStore.md): Behaviour for pluggable credential storage backends.
  - [ADK.Auth.InMemoryStore](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Auth.InMemoryStore.md): In-memory credential store using an Agent process.

- Runner
  - [ADK.Runner](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Runner.md): Orchestrates agent execution — creates sessions, runs agents, collects events.

  - [ADK.Runner.Async](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Runner.Async.md): Runs an agent asynchronously under `ADK.RunnerSupervisor` (Task.Supervisor),
sending events back to the caller as `{:adk_event, event}` messages.

- A2A Protocol
  - [ADK.A2A.AgentCard](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.A2A.AgentCard.md): Generates an A2A Agent Card from an ADK agent.
  - [ADK.A2A.Client](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.A2A.Client.md): A2A protocol client — delegates to `A2A.Client` from the
[a2a](https://github.com/zeroasterisk/a2a-elixir) package.
  - [ADK.A2A.Message](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.A2A.Message.md): Converts between ADK Events and A2A protocol messages.
  - [ADK.A2A.RemoteAgentTool](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.A2A.RemoteAgentTool.md): Wraps a remote A2A agent as an ADK tool.
  - [ADK.A2A.Server](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.A2A.Server.md): A2A protocol server for ADK agents, implemented as a Plug.

- Phoenix Integration
  - [ADK.Phoenix.Channel](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Phoenix.Channel.md): A `use`-able module that adds ADK agent interaction to a Phoenix Channel.
  - [ADK.Phoenix.ChatLive](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Phoenix.ChatLive.md): Production-quality Phoenix LiveView chat interface for ADK agents.
  - [ADK.Phoenix.Controller](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Phoenix.Controller.md): Helper functions for building Phoenix controllers that interact with ADK agents.
  - [ADK.Phoenix.LiveHandler](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Phoenix.LiveHandler.md): A `use`-able module that adds ADK agent interaction to a Phoenix LiveView.
  - [ADK.Phoenix.WebRouter](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Phoenix.WebRouter.md): Plug router providing Python ADK-compatible HTTP endpoints.

- Plugins
  - [ADK.Plugin](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.md): Global plugin behaviour for intercepting the Runner pipeline.
  - [ADK.Plugin.ReflectRetry](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.ReflectRetry.md): A plugin that validates LLM responses and retries with reflection feedback
when they don't meet quality criteria.
  - [ADK.Plugin.Registry](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Plugin.Registry.md): Agent-based registry for global plugins.

- MCP
  - [ADK.MCP.Client](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.MCP.Client.md): MCP (Model Context Protocol) client over stdio transport.
  - [ADK.MCP.ToolAdapter](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.MCP.ToolAdapter.md): Converts MCP server tools into ADK `FunctionTool` structs.

- Oban
  - [ADK.Oban.AgentWorker](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Oban.AgentWorker.md): Oban worker for durable agent execution.

- Policies
  - [ADK.Policy](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Policy.md): Policy behaviour for agent governance — tool access control, content filtering, etc.
  - [ADK.Policy.DefaultPolicy](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Policy.DefaultPolicy.md): A permissive default policy that allows everything and passes content through unchanged.

- Eval
  - [ADK.Eval](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Eval.md): Evaluation framework for testing agent quality.
  - [ADK.Eval.Case](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Eval.Case.md): Defines a single evaluation test case.
  - [ADK.Eval.Report](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Eval.Report.md): Summary report of an evaluation run.
  - [ADK.Eval.Result](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Eval.Result.md): Result of evaluating a single test case.
  - [ADK.Eval.Scorer](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Eval.Scorer.md): Behaviour for evaluation scorers.
  - [ADK.Eval.Scorer.Contains](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Eval.Scorer.Contains.md): Scores 1.0 if the response text contains the given substring.
  - [ADK.Eval.Scorer.ExactMatch](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Eval.Scorer.ExactMatch.md): Scores 1.0 if the response text exactly matches the expected text.
  - [ADK.Eval.Scorer.ResponseLength](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Eval.Scorer.ResponseLength.md): Scores based on whether response length is within a min/max character range.
  - [ADK.Eval.Scorer.ToolUsed](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Eval.Scorer.ToolUsed.md): Scores 1.0 if the agent called a specific tool (function) by name.

- Telemetry
  - [ADK.Telemetry](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Telemetry.md): Telemetry events for the ADK pipeline.
  - [ADK.Telemetry.DebugHandler](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Telemetry.DebugHandler.md): Telemetry handler that captures ADK events into `ADK.Telemetry.SpanStore`.
  - [ADK.Telemetry.SpanStore](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Telemetry.SpanStore.md): ETS-backed store for debug/trace span data.

- Internal
  - [ADK.Application](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Application.md): OTP Application for ADK.
  - [ADK.Callback](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Callback.md): Callback hooks for agent, model, and tool invocations.
  - [ADK.InstructionCompiler](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.InstructionCompiler.md): Compiles the system instruction for an LLM agent by combining

- Exceptions
  - [ADK.Error](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/ADK.Error.md): Structured error types for the ADK.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix adk.doctor](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Adk.Doctor.md): Validates your environment for ADK Elixir development.

- Mix Tasks
  - [mix adk.gen.migration](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Adk.Gen.Migration.md): Generates an Ecto migration for the ADK sessions table.
  - [mix adk.new](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Adk.New.md): Creates a new ADK agent project.
  - [mix adk.server](https://adk.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Adk.Server.md): Starts an ADK development server with a browser-based chat UI.
